messages:
Hannah Li: ACME legal wants a binding timeline in the POC: 24h ack, 48h confirmed notice, plus CAIQ in 3bd. Can we give that?

Omar Khan: Ops: we can ACK suspected incidents within 24h of detection. '48h confirmed' is tight; our standard is notify of confirmed breaches within 72h of confirmation. We should avoid committing to 48h in SOW unless legal signs off. :thinking_face:

Samantha Reed: Legal: we can accept 24h ack + 72h confirmed. Proposed SOW language to copy: "Provider will acknowledge suspected security incidents affecting Customer within 24 hours of detection and will notify Customer of any confirmed data breach within 72 hours of confirmation. Provider will provide an initial summary and use commercially reasonable efforts to deliver a final incident report typically within 21 calendar days."

Hannah Li: Buyer asked for list of artifacts if exfiltration suspected (network captures, hashes, logs, timeline). They want to include a deliverables appendix.

Omar Khan: We can provide: access logs, authentication events, timeline of actions, hashes/IOCs, redacted forensic artifacts, and a list of affected resources. We do NOT share raw PII or full disk images. Add redaction clause in the artifact list.

ops-bot: IR playbook link: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/ir-v4 (internal access)

Samantha Reed: Also add regulatory clause: "If applicable law requires notification (e.g., GDPR), Provider and Customer will coordinate timing and content; Provider will not publish details without Customer consent except where disclosure is legally required." Legal will own regulatory comms.

Hannah Li: CAIQ: we can commit to returning our prefilled CAIQ within 3 business days for standard question sets. Full SIG or customized questionnaires will be scoped separately and usually take 10-21 business days depending on complexity.

Omar Khan: Operationally we'll add an IR contact block into the SOW for the POC: IR inbox (ir@redwood.com), named IR lead (omar@redwood.com), backup IR (samantha@redwood.com), and escalation pager +1-555-IR-999.

Samantha Reed: Add an embargo/confidentiality sentence: "Provider and Customer will coordinate public communications and will not disclose incident details without mutual agreement except as required by law."

Hannah Li: I'll send ACME the SOW snippet, artifact appendix template, CAIQ prefill link, and the IR contact block. Will let you know when they respond.

Omar Khan: Quick ops note: if they insist on 48h confirmed, we can offer it as a paid SLA addendum with additional monitoring/commitments. Otherwise recommend 72h default.

Hannah Li: Good idea. I'll flag SLA addendum option in the reply. Closing loop once ACME ACKs.
